disclaimer.title: A support tool, not medical advice
disclaimer.short: Afyabora helps you track your blood glucose. It does not diagnose and does not replace the advice of a healthcare professional.
disclaimer.intro: Afyabora is a support tool for diabetes self-monitoring. Before using it, it is important to know what it does, and above all what it does not do.

does.title: What Afyabora does
does.body: It records your readings, even offline. It computes simple figures from your own data (averages, time in your target range, high or low episodes). It helps you prepare your appointment and share your history with the doctor you choose.

doesNot.title: What it does not do
doesNot.body: It never makes a diagnosis. It never suggests an insulin dose or any medication. It never states the cause of a high or low reading: its observations are leads to discuss with a professional.

quality.title: Results depend on your entries
quality.body: The figures are only as accurate as the readings: a mistyped value or days without readings change the results. The app tells you when there is too little data to draw conclusions.

treatment.title: Your treatment
treatment.body: Never change your treatment based on the app alone. Talk to your doctor or care team first.

alerts.title: Reminders and alerts
alerts.body: Reminders and alerts may not arrive (phone off, empty battery, notifications disabled). They do not replace your own vigilance or that of your relatives.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Your health data belongs to you. This page explains, simply, what we store, why, where, and who can see it.
privacy.prototype: Afyabora is currently a prototype built as part of a training programme. This policy will be reviewed with our supervisors before any public release.

data.title: The data we store
data.body: Your account: email address and password (never stored in plain text). Your profile: name, date of birth, sex, diabetes type, year of diagnosis, chosen unit and thresholds. If you wish: a relative to contact and your doctor. Your follow-up: blood glucose readings, events (meals, activity, treatment…) and notes.

purpose.title: Why
purpose.body: Only for your follow-up: showing your history, computing your statistics and preparing your appointments. No advertising. Your data is never sold or rented.

storage.title: Where it is kept
storage.body: First on your phone, so the app works offline, then on our server as soon as a connection is available. Exchanges are encrypted, your personal notes are encrypted on the server, and you can lock the app with a code or your fingerprint. When you sign out, the data is erased from the phone.

sharing.title: Sharing with a doctor
sharing.body: Nothing is shared without your action. You generate a QR code, valid for a short time and only once; only a signed-in, verified doctor can scan it. You choose what they see and for how long, you can stop sharing at any time, and every access appears in your access log.

emergency.title: The emergency card
emergency.body: If you turn it on, the emergency card can be read without an account: that is its purpose, for first responders. It only contains the information you chose, never your history. Every opening is reported to you, and you can turn it off or renew it at any time.

analysis.title: Analyses
analysis.body: Figures and observations are computed by the app using fixed, verifiable rules, from your data only. If automatic rewording of texts is ever enabled, it will only receive summarised figures, without your name or contact details.

retention.title: How long
retention.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. Deleting the account erases your data from our servers.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can get a copy of your data, correct it and delete your account. The consent given at sign-up can be withdrawn by deleting your account. You are never required to share your data with a doctor.
